$$\begin{aligned}s(-1)&\approx-5+(-2)=-7\\s(0)&=-4+(-4)=-8\\s(1)&\approx-3+(-6)=-9.\end{aligned}$$
Plot further ordinate sums and join them smoothly, retaining the falling left-hand and rising right-hand continuation. The positive $x$-intercept is about $(2.3,0)$. The change from $g(x)$ varies with $x$, so it is not a vertical translation.
